abstract: Eight patients with the diagnosis of anaplastic seminoma of the testicle were treated during the megavoltage era from January 1959 to January 1976. Two patients with Stage I disease and one patient with Stage IV disease have died from their malignancy. By contrast, 57 patients with typical seminoma were treated during the same interval and with the same treatment methods. However, only two patients with typical seminoma have died. One of these patients had Stage II disease and one had Stage IV disease. There were no deaths among patients with Stage I typical seminoma. These results suggest that anaplastic seminoma has a poorer prognosis than typical seminoma even when the diseases are compared stage for stage. Implications for therapy are discussed.
abstract_ja: 1959年1月から1976年1月までのメガボルテージ期に、精巣の未分化セミノーマと診断された8例を治療した。病期I 2例と病期IV 1例が悪性腫瘍で死亡した。これに対し、同時期に同様の治療法で治療した通常型セミノーマ57例では、死亡は2例のみであった。通常型セミノーマの病期IIと病期IVの各1例が死亡している。通常型セミノーマの病期I患者では死亡例がなかった。これらの結果から、未分化セミノーマは病期を揃えて比較しても通常型セミノーマより予後が不良であることが示唆される。治療への示唆についても考察する。
